ANSWER: NO
HALLUCINATIONS: None

All key financial terms in the memo are supported by the source document:

- Date (November 30, 2020), parties (Bank of Montreal as Administrative Agent, MGE Niagara Entertainment Inc. as Borrower, Complex Services Inc. as guarantor), and waiver period through March 31, 2021 are all accurately stated
- Interest rates from Level 5 pricing (5.00% for Bankers' Acceptances/Letters of Credit/LIBOR Loans, 3.50% for Prime Rate Loans/USBR Loans) are correctly taken from Schedule B
- Minimum liquidity requirement of $15,000,000 is directly stated in section 2(c)
- Restrictions on advances, distributions, and other covenants are accurately reflected from section 2
- Extension fee of 5 basis points is correctly stated from section 4
- Weekly liquidity reporting requirement is supported by section 2(f)
- COVID-19 closure impacts, OLG financial relief, and related background are all supported by the WHEREAS clauses

The memo accurately summarizes and presents the financial terms from the source waiver document without adding unsupported information.

ANSWER: YES
MISSING_TERMS: 
- Original credit agreement date (June 10, 2019, amended July 17, 2019)
- Extended Waiver Period definition (from date of waiver until March 31, 2021)
- Specific financial covenants being waived (Sections 9.4.1 and 9.4.2 of Credit Agreement)
- Timeline of previous waivers and extensions (May 2020, June 2020, July 2020, September 2020)
- Undrawn fee rate (1.25% at Level 5)
- Complete pricing grid for all levels (not just Level 5)
- OLG payment disruption thresholds (5 business days for both threshold relief and Fixed Component Per Diem)
- Specific compliance certificate delivery waivers (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4 and annual certificates)
- Annual Business Plan delivery waiver
